summary: Lidia Wojtczak is a scholar in Indology and linguistics. She served as Lecturer in Sanskrit at SOAS University of London (2015–2024) before becoming Associate Instructional Professor in Sanskrit at the University of Chicago in 2024.
Lifei Pan specializes in Buddhist studies and Sinology. Pan studied at Sichuan University and Ghent University, later holding a postdoctoral post at Sichuan University in 2021.
Lili Zheng is a scholar of Buddhist studies who earned a Master of Arts at Fo Guang University, studying under supervisor Yongdong Shi (attested 2011).

Lilian Silburn (1908–1993) worked in Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. She studied under Paul Masson-Oursel, Louis Renou, and Swami Lakshman Joo, and held research posts at the CNRS from around 1946 to 1974.

Lilias Homburger (1880–1969) was an Indologist and linguist who studied under Antoine Meillet. She served as directeur d’études at the École Pratique des Hautes Études (~1914–1940) and taught at the Institut national des langues et civilisations orientales.

Lilla Russell-Smith works in history, archaeology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and Buddhist studies. She studied under Anna Eörsi and Pál Miklós, and completed a PhD at SOAS University of London.

Lily de Silva worked in Indology and Buddhist studies. She studied under Julius Berugoda and M. Sri Rammandala, and held posts at the University of Ceylon (attested 1970) and the University of Peradeniya (attested 2008).

Limei Chi specializes in Buddhist studies and Sinology and studied under Jinhua Chen. Chi held posts as faculty at the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies and Professor at the International Institute for Buddhist Studies (both attested 2026).

Lin He (1902–1992) was a philosopher who studied at Tsinghua University (National Tsing Hua University) from circa 1919 to 1926. He later held a post at National Tsing Hua University from circa 1931 to 1937.
Lin Heng specializes in Indology and Buddhist studies. Heng earned an MA at Silpakorn University, studying under supervisor Chainarong Klinnoi (attested 2015).
Lin Li is a researcher in computational linguistics who has held posts at Utrecht University and Qinghai Normal University.
Lina Wang works in Buddhist studies and Sinology. She studied at Peking University and held a post at the National Library of China.

Lincoln T. Zacconi is a scholar of philosophy and Indology. Zacconi pursued specialization studies at Faculdade da Aldeia de Carapicuíba in 2016 and was a master's student at the University of São Paulo in 2017.

Linda Hogan (born 1964) is a religious studies scholar. Educated at Maynooth and Trinity College Dublin (PhD 1991), she taught at Chester and Leeds before holding posts at Trinity College Dublin, including Vice-Provost (2011–2016).
Linda Jean LaMacchia is a scholar of Indology and religious studies who completed a PhD at the University of Wisconsin-Madison under the supervision of David M. Knipe (attested 2001).
Linda Learman works in religious studies and Buddhist studies. She studied under doctoral supervisor Robert P. Weller and postdoctoral mentor Peter N. Gregory (attested 2005).
Linda Penkower is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology. She earned her PhD from Columbia University in 1993 and was a research fellow at Taisho University (attested 1983).

Linda York Leach (1942–2006) was a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. She completed her education at the University of Michigan and Case Western Reserve University, where she earned her PhD (~1970–1978).
Lindsay G. McCune is a scholar of Tibetology and religious studies. McCune studied under Kathleen M. Erndl, John Corrigan, and MA supervisor Bryan J. Cuevas.
Lindy Li Mark (born 1932) is a Sinologist who held appointments as professor of anthropology at California State University, East Bay, and at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
